comparisons.peer_topic: New Market Competition and Investment Returns
comparisons.peer_summary: New businesses in AI, cloud-to-edge, and other areas introduce new competition and require significant investment with no guarantee of adequate returns. Failures in AI products or the foundry business could lead to asset impairments, restructuring charges, and opportunity costs.
comparisons.comparison: Both AVGO and INTC disclose risks regarding the returns on significant research and development investments, particularly in emerging areas like AI. AVGO states generally that slow or unsuccessful returns on R&D investments could adversely affect the company. INTC provides a more detailed breakdown, noting that developing products in new areas (such as AI and foundry services) require significant investment with no guarantee of adequate returns, and specifically cites the risk of asset impairments and restructuring charges if these investments fail or do not achieve market acceptance.

sentences.text: • We make investments in research and development and the slow or unsuccessful return of our investments in research and development could adversely affect us.

These developing products and market segments require significant investment, do not always grow as projected or at all, or sometimes adopt competing technologies, and we may not realize an adequate return on our investments.

Despite our ongoing efforts, there is no guarantee that we will achieve or maintain market demand or acceptance for our products and services in these various market segments or realize an adequate return on our investments, which could lead to impairment of assets and restructuring charges, as well as opportunity costs.

comparisons.peer_summary: Unsuccessful efforts to develop new memory and storage technologies and products could have a material adverse effect on the company's business, results of operations, or financial condition.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO and MU both disclose risks associated with unsuccessful efforts to develop new technologies. AVGO notes that unsuccessful returns on R&D investments could adversely affect the company. MU explicitly states that unsuccessful efforts to develop new memory and storage technologies and products could have a material adverse effect on its business, results of operations, or financial condition. Both disclosures center on the hazard that innovation efforts may fail to yield commercially viable products or adequate returns.

comparisons.peer_topic: Risks of R&D investments in markets with limited history
comparisons.peer_summary: Investments in research and development for markets where NVIDIA has a limited operating history may not produce meaningful revenue for several years or at all, particularly if new products fail to obtain design wins or achieve widespread adoption.
comparisons.comparison: AVGO and NVDA both highlight the risk that R&D investments may not generate timely or sufficient revenue. AVGO warns that slow or unsuccessful returns on R&D could adversely affect the business. NVDA specifically addresses investments in markets with limited operating history, noting they may not produce meaningful revenue for several years or at all, and emphasizes that failure to develop or monetize new products adversely affects financial results. Both firms link R&D spending directly to the uncertainty of commercial success and revenue generation.
